Proposed intervention: Modify the chiller load-ramp schedule and cooling-water temperature setpoint to prevent supersaturation during transients. Standard practice typically allows aggressive load ramps and ignores the tight coupling between generator temperature and dilution limits. This mitigation departs by restricting the load-ramp rate to a calculated physical limit and raising the cooling-water setpoint to reduce the equilibrium crystallization margin. The governing relation is $\sigma \approx 1 + \Delta C/C_{eq}$.
